labels.rationale: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma diagnosed February 2022 and treated with ABVD (2023 hematology note, narrative paragraph) is another malignancy within 5 years. The 2023 basal-cell carcinoma is an allowed exception, but the lymphoma is not.
Pembrolizumab (a PD-1 inhibitor) given June to August 2024, documented only in the 2024 outside consult narrative.

FOLFIRI given 2026-04-08 (infusion record) and cycle 1 day 1 scheduled for 2026-04-20 (screening letter): 12 days apart, inside the 4-week window. UNKNOWN is acceptable because the scheduled date could move; clearing it (MEETS) is unsafe.
KRAS G12C mutation documented on the pathology report.
Colorectal adenocarcinoma documented (liver biopsy and oncology note); prior Hodgkin lymphoma or basal-cell carcinoma must not confuse the diagnosis.
